preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 10**5 for n in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For every test case, the integer n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of test case inputs matches T.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n and x != i+1 for i, x in enumerate(p)) and set(p) == set(range(1, n+1)) and len(p) == n for n, p in zip(test_cases, [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in output_lines]))
postconditions.description: For each test case n, the output line represents a permutation of length n where every element is in [1, n], all elements are distinct, and no element equals its 1-based index (p[i] != i+1).

postconditions.expression: all(all(p[i] <= q[i] for i in range(len(p))) and any(p[i] < q[i] for i in range(len(p))) or p == q for n, p in zip(test_cases, [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in output_lines]) for q in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in output_lines] if q != p)
postconditions.description: The output permutation for each test case is the lexicographically smallest among all valid good permutations for that n.
